summary.text: Mason Barclay is the Democratic candidate for the Indiana House of Representatives, District 75, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Republican incumbent Cindy Ledbetter.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a 28-year-old lifelong resident of Warrick County and said he is focused on lowering everyday costs for working families.

paragraphs.text: Mason Barclay said in a Ballotpedia survey that he is a lifelong resident of Warrick County, is 28 years old, and has been involved in his community for years.
He said he has worked in District 75 his whole life and is running a grassroots campaign.
Barclay said his campaign is focused on utility bills, healthcare costs, and wages, and that he opposes private school voucher programs and wants to keep public tax dollars in public classrooms.

He also said he wants to stop mandates such as Senate Bill 1 that he said reduce municipal budgets, and that he supports fully funding public education, expanding access to affordable healthcare, and protecting the environment.
